changes.what: packages/control-plane/wrangler.jsonc: adds migrations_dir for the DB binding, pointing at terraform/d1/migrations
changes.why: Production is deployed with Terraform, which applies these migrations. The repository's Wrangler config is the one its Worker tests use, and it has no migrations_dir.

knownFailures.step: a subscribed client stays connected while the session hibernates
knownFailures.note: WebSocket hibernation is not available on Rivet 3. Orange emulates it: it drops the idle object and keeps its sockets open, but the Rivet actor does not sleep while a socket is open. This step waits for every actor to sleep, so it fails with: Some actor was still awake.
